bio.placeOfBirth: Harbel City, Lower Margibi County, Liberia
bio.summary: Martha Kolleh is a Liberian right-back and right winger currently with Small Town Football Academy. She came through Hippo Football Academy, progressed to Hippo FC's senior team, and spent three seasons with Ravia Angels before signing with Small Town Football Academy.

career.title: Hippo Football Academy
career.note: Began her football journey in the academy system.

career.title: Hippo FC — Senior Team
career.note: Earned promotion from the academy to Hippo FC's senior side.

career.title: Loan Spell — Ravia Angels
career.note: Went out on loan to Ravia Angels before returning to Hippo FC.

career.title: Ravia Angels — Permanent Move
career.note: Completed a permanent transfer to Ravia Angels, where she spent three seasons.

career.title: Small Town Football Academy
career.note: Signed a two-season deal ahead of the upcoming season.

nationalTeam.note: Represents Liberia at senior national team level.
